name: Karim El-Sayed
bio: Karim leads the database platform team at Fawry, where he's spent the last six years scaling PostgreSQL to handle Egypt's largest digital payment network. He's a frequent speaker on high-availability Postgres architectures.

name: Nourhan Adel
bio: Nourhan works on Instabug's core data platform, where query performance directly affects thousands of mobile engineering teams worldwide. She's passionate about making indexing concepts approachable for engineers of all levels.

name: Ahmed Farouk
bio: Ahmed has spent his career scaling transactional systems across logistics and fintech in the MENA region, with deep experience running Postgres at high write volumes.

name: Mariam Hassan
bio: Mariam builds and maintains the replication and disaster-recovery systems behind MaxAB's B2B commerce platform, and enjoys demystifying Postgres internals for application developers.

name: Youssef Nabil
bio: Youssef builds location-aware healthcare products on top of PostGIS, and has worked on geospatial systems across several Cairo-based startups.

name: Salma Mostafa
bio: Salma led the team behind Breadfast's migration from a legacy Oracle system to PostgreSQL, and now talks widely about the practical, unglamorous realities of database migrations.

name: Omar Khaled
bio: Omar works with enterprise customers across the region adopting managed Postgres in the cloud, and is active in growing open-source database communities in Egypt.

name: Dina Ashraf
bio: Dina works directly with the open-source PostgreSQL community across EMEA, helping local user groups get started and grow.
